<module id="freq_divbyfrac">
    <description>A frequency divider that divides the input clock frequency by fractional values. It generates a clock signal with a fractional frequency division (3.5x), using the double-edge clocking technique to achieve half-integer division while adjusting for duty cycle imbalance.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Input clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active low reset signal to initialize the module.</input>
        <output id="clk_div">Fractionally divided clock output.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>
        // Internal signals
        reg [3:0] cnt;
        reg [3:0] MUL2_DIV_CLK;
        reg div_clk;
        reg div_clk_delayed;
        reg div_clk_advanced;
        
        // Parameters
        localparam N = 3;       // Number of bits for counter
        localparam D = 7;       // Division factor
        
        // Counter to generate the fractional division
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                cnt <= 0;
            end else begin
                if (cnt == D-1) begin
                    cnt <= 0;
                end else begin
                    cnt <= cnt + 1;
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Generate the divided clock signal based on the counter value
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                div_clk <= 0;
            end else begin
                if ((cnt >= 0 && cnt < 3) || (cnt >= 4 && cnt < 7)) begin
                    div_clk <= ~div_clk;     // Toggle every 4th cycle
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Delay the divided clock signal by half-period
        always @(negedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                div_clk_delayed <= 0;
            end else begin
                if ((cnt >= 1 && cnt < 4) || (cnt >= 5 && cnt < 8)) begin
                    div_clk_delayed <= ~div_clk_delayed; // Toggle every 3rd cycle
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Advance the divided clock signal by half-period
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                div_clk_advanced <= 0;
            end else begin
                if ((cnt >= 2 && cnt < 5) || (cnt >= 6 && cnt < 9)) begin
                    div_clk_advanced <= ~div_clk_advanced; // Toggle every 3rd cycle
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Output the final divided clock signal after combining the three clocks
        assign clk_div = div_clk | div_clk_delayed | div_clk_advanced;
    </implementation>
</module>
